name: get_business_health
description: Returns current health score and high-level component metrics of the business.

name: get_revenue_summary
description: Returns top-line revenue, average order value, and percentage growth.

name: get_revenue_breakdown
description: Decomposes revenue change into dimensions (volume effect vs price effect) and identifies root causes.

name: get_customer_segments
description: Returns Recency, Frequency, Monetary (RFM) analysis and customer opportunity segments.

name: get_inventory_risk
description: Returns stock coverage, items at stockout risk, and overstock warnings.
